why: I checked every name the issue uses against the repository. bin/greet.js, src/greet.js and its `greeting` function, docs/index.md, .github/workflows/pages.yml, test/greet.test.js and `npm test` (package.json has "test": "node --test") all exist. The quoted argv line matches bin/greet.js exactly. The problem statement is accurate: flags starting with `--` are dropped, so `--shout Ada` prints `Hello, Ada!`. pages.yml publishes docs/ on pushes to main. The URL comes from the README. docs/index.md only shows `node bin/greet.js <name>`. Running with no name prints `usage: greet <name>` and exits with status 2, as the expectation says. The bare `greet --shout <name>` in the outcome has no package.json bin entry behind it. I accepted it as the CLI's own name, since the usage string uses it, not as a claim about an installed command. Every file, command and function the issue names is grounded.
